trait.name: Aura of Winter
entries: Allies within 10 ft. of Eva gains the effects of {@spell fire shield} spell (chill shield).

trait.name: Cold Regeneration
entries: If the temperature around her is 0°F (-18°C) or lower, Eva regains 15 hit points at the start of her turn. If she takes fire damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of her next turn. Eva dies only if she starts her turn with 0 hit points and doesn't regenerate.

action.name: Staff
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 2} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}2 ({@damage 1d6 - 1}) damage.

action.name: Channel Divinity (2/Day)
entries: Eva can use her Channel Divinity to either {@classFeature Turn Undead|Cleric|XPHB|2|XPHB|Turn Undead} or to {@classFeature Divine Spark|Cleric|XPHB|2|XPHB|Divine Spark}.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: Eva casts one of the following spells, using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 15}):

reaction.name: Guided Strike {@recharge 5}
entries: When Eva or a creature within 30 feet of her misses with an attack roll, Eva can give that roll a +10 bonus, potentially causing it to hit.

Eva Perire is a human cleric devoted to {@deity Tempus}, raised in Bryn Shander under the care of {@creature Sephek Kaltro|IDRotL} alongside her twin brother, {@creature Adan Perire|IDRotL}. Unlike many orphans, she grew up under strict discipline, learning early to value both prayer and steel. Her faith in Tempus has been unwavering since childhood, and {@creature Sephek Kaltro|IDRotL} encouraged her to follow the path of the war god's clergy.

At fourteen, Eva began serving as {@creature Sephek Kaltro|IDRotL}'s squire. She accompanied him and {@creature Adan Perire|IDRotL} on mercenary contracts, tending to his equipment, assisting in the field, and watching battles unfold at his side. Though still young, she has been shaped by these journeys, gaining firsthand knowledge of survival and service while remaining loyal to the orphanage that gave her shelter.
